controllerType: 58420B-A Series Controller (C3 heat sink, enhanced IGBT)

keyImprovements: 12mm closed presser foot for tent fabrics
DLC/QPQ surface treatment on take-up lever
4 automatic oil supply model variants (-Y suffix)

buttons: Reset - Restore factory settings (hold 3s in standby)
Needle Position - Toggle needle up/down stop mode

displayIndicators.needleUp: Upper segment of rightmost digital display lit
displayIndicators.needleDown: Lower segment of rightmost digital display lit
displayIndicators.noNeedleStop: Neither segment lit on rightmost display
displayIndicators.stopMode: Third digital tube upper segment lit horizontally
displayIndicators.normalMode: Third digital tube not lit horizontally

operations.speedAdjust: Short press + or - in standby (±100 rpm per press)
operations.stopMode: Short press Stop button to toggle; third digital tube horizontal = stop mode (machine will not run)
operations.needlePosition: Short press Needle Position to cycle: up → down → off
operations.factoryReset: Long press Reset for 3s in standby to restore factory defaults
operations.internalSpeedLimit: Hold P + Needle Position after power on → enter password → access PE0 parameter (limits max adjustable speed)

parameterEntry.user: Long press P in standby → user parameter mode. Short press S to enter value. Use ◄/► to select digit. Use +/- to change value. Press S to save (shows 'ok'). Press P to exit.
parameterEntry.technician: Hold P + S while turning on machine. Adjustment method same as user parameters.
parameterEntry.monitoring: Long press P + Needle Position key in standby → monitoring mode. Use ◄/► to select item. Use +/- to scroll items. Press S to view value. Press S again to return. Press P to exit.
parameterEntry.rnd: Hold P + Stop button while turning on machine. Enter P-E1 password (default 718) to access R&D parameters.

errorCodes.solution: Power off, wait 30s, restart. If controller still does not work properly, replace controller and notify manufacturer.
Power off, wait 30s, restart. If controller still does not work properly, replace controller and notify manufacturer.
Disconnect controller power. Check if input voltage is below 154V. Restart after voltage returns to normal. If still faulty, replace controller.
Disconnect controller power. Check if input voltage exceeds 264V. Restart after voltage returns to normal. If still faulty, replace controller.
Disconnect controller power. Check if input voltage exceeds 264V. Restart after voltage returns to normal. If still faulty, replace controller.
Power off, restart after 30s to see if it works. Try again several times. If fault occurs frequently, replace controller.
Disconnect controller power. Check if motor input plug is detached, loose, or damaged. Check for foreign matter wrapped around machine head. If still faulty after restart, replace controller.

errorCodes.description: Spindle motor initial angle detection fault
errorCodes.solution: Enter parameter settings to check initial angle. Power off and retry 2-3 times. If fault persists, replace controller.
Power off, check spindle motor encoder connector (loose or detached). Restore to normal and restart. Replace spindle motor encoder if needed. If still faulty, replace controller.

errorCodes.description: Main control storage component read/write failure
errorCodes.solution: Power off, restart after 30s. If still faulty, replace controller.
Power off, restart after 30s. If still faulty, replace controller.
Power off, restart after 30s. If still faulty, replace controller.
Check if spindle motor is blocked. If not blocked, replace controller.
Power off, restart after 30s. If still faulty, replace controller.
Power off, check speed regulator connector (not plugged in, loose, or detached). Replace speed regulator if needed.

alarmCodes.description: Power off / supply voltage too low
Motor sleep — machine idle ~55 minutes without running
alarmCodes.solution: Press any key to wake machine. Decimal point of last digital tube flashes during sleep. Adjust P55 to change sleep time or set to 0 to disable.

alarmCodes.description: Lift switch alarm — machine head tipped over
alarmCodes.solution: Straighten machine head and restore flip switch to normal. Long press S key to clear alarm and turn off tipping detection function.

alarmCodes.description: Machine head button short circuit alarm
alarmCodes.solution: Turn off system power and replace the headlight button.

parameters.name: Start Sewing Speed

monitoring.name: Pedal Return Center Analog Value

troubleshooting.cause: Hardware or software overcurrent protection triggered
troubleshooting.solution: Power off for 30 seconds, then restart. If recurring, replace controller.
Check power supply. Wait for voltage to normalize, then restart. Replace controller if fault persists after normal voltage restored.
Check power supply. Wait for voltage to normalize, then restart.

troubleshooting.cause: Motor blocked by obstruction, plug loose, or damaged
troubleshooting.solution: Check motor power plug connection. Check for foreign matter around machine head. Restart after clearing obstruction. Replace controller if needed.

troubleshooting.cause: Spindle motor encoder connector loose, detached, or encoder failed
troubleshooting.solution: Check and reseat encoder connector. Replace spindle motor encoder if damaged.

troubleshooting.cause: Speed regulator connector not plugged in or loose
troubleshooting.solution: Check and reseat speed regulator connector. Replace speed regulator if needed.

troubleshooting.cause: Machine head tilt safety switch triggered
troubleshooting.solution: Straighten machine head, restore flip switch. Long press S to clear alarm. Long press S again to disable tipping detection if switch is faulty.
Press any key to wake. Set P55 to desired auto-sleep time (in minutes) or 0 to disable sleep.

troubleshooting.cause: Short circuit in machine head button/headlight
troubleshooting.solution: Power off immediately, replace the headlight button.

troubleshooting.issue: Maximum speed cannot be increased beyond current limit
troubleshooting.cause: P68 technician parameter and/or P-E0 R&D parameter restricting speed
troubleshooting.solution: Check P68 (technician mode) — default 2800rpm. To increase above 2800rpm, access R&D mode (P + Stop at startup, default password 718) and raise P-E0 up to 3200rpm, then increase P68 accordingly.

troubleshooting.issue: Machine does not run (stop mode active)
troubleshooting.cause: Stop mode enabled via Stop button
troubleshooting.solution: Short press Stop button to toggle back to normal sewing mode. Third digital tube horizontal lit = stop mode.

mechanicalAdjustments.needleBarHeight: When needle bar at lowest, needle chuck should be 12.3mm from needle plate. Second scale on needle bar should be flush with needle bar sleeve.
mechanicalAdjustments.hookThreadAdjustment: When needle bar rises 1-1.5mm above needle hole from lowest point, hook tip should align with center of needle. Gap between hook and needle must be maintained.
mechanicalAdjustments.hookThreadGap: Thread dividing hook gap approximately 0.2mm when at farthest point. Too small = abnormal noise; too large = thread jam.
mechanicalAdjustments.toothHeight: Feed dog tooth ~1mm above needle plate at highest point
mechanicalAdjustments.toothAlignment: Needle must insert into center of tooth hole without touching front/back of tooth or left/right of needle plate
mechanicalAdjustments.hookOilAdjustment: Hook total oil volume screw controls both hooks; individual left/right hook screws control independently. Adjust based on fabric type.
mechanicalAdjustments.reverseForwardOverlap: Loosen eccentric fixing screw; turn eccentric in A direction to increase reverse stitch, B direction to decrease, until lengths overlap
